// How the interior of a self-intersecting or multi-contour path is decided.
// NonZero: inside where the winding count is nonzero. EvenOdd: inside where
// the crossing count is odd. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nonzero-rule)
type FillRule = NonZero | EvenOdd;
